proof: A multiprocessing-spawn acceptance raced two independent service modules against one SOURCE_INGEST_DATA_DIR and observed one connector config, one schedule, one frontier id, one ingest run id, and one SourceRecord.
JSONL mutation paths reload durable state while holding stable sidecar exclusive file locks; frontier enqueue and claim are atomic against the latest shared log.
SourceHealth metadata.last_outcome reports success, policy_denial, credential_unavailable, or provider_failure with stable typed category and code.
One provider failure is isolated to its connector while the scheduler continues to account for other due connectors.
Persona.required_data_sources admission converges the deterministic connector and connector schedule before any provider execution.
Only the durable frontier claimant creates the correlated ingest run and normalized SourceRecord.
Controller state reports ticks missed while the worker was down and the startup missed-tick test proves the persisted restart readback.
A stale running frontier is durably recovered after restart without creating a duplicate SourceRecord.
Reconcile-only mode rejects the tick when SourceRecord, dead-letter, or frontier backlog counts change, so schedule intent cannot be misreported as a provider pull.
Frontier claim ownership and bounded retry state prevent a stale or competing worker from materializing duplicate downstream effects.
